scope: Theorem 4.1 (Sparse-pair description) of the manuscript “The sharp logarithmic exponent of r(5,t)” (preprints/The-Sharp-Logarithmic-Exponent-of-r-5-t-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 170 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 71adbadd9abac57b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix 0 < η < 1/10, set β = η/107, and let q be a sufficiently large prime. Write σ = log q, and suppose σβ ≤ D ≤ σ1−η/2 , L = Dσ8β , R ∈ [σβ , 2σβ + 2] ∩ 2N, P = LR. Let 2 ≤ d ≤ 4, and let S ⊆ US ⊆ Pd and T ⊆ UT ⊆ P∗ d be nonempty. Assume |S||T| ≥ qd+1 e−b , 0 ≤ b ≤ CbDσ6β , e(S, T) |S||T| ≤ τ q , 0 < τ ≤ σ−200·2d−2β , where Cb is a fixed constant. Put dS = log(|US|/|S|) and dT = log(|UT |/|T|). Orient the pair so that |S| ≤ |T|. There is a public-table scheme for which, except with probability O(e−cq), the encoder can send a message of length at most CqP(dS + dT + P) bits describing a set W ⊆ US such that |W| ≤ |S|eCP , |W ∩ S| ≥ c|S|. The constants may depend on η, Cb, but not on the hidden sets, D, or q. The decoder uses only US, UT , the public parameters and tables, and the message. There is no uniformity assertion for the captured subset W ∩ S.
